correctness.rationale: The proof exhausts the connected-component types allowed by maximum term-overlap degree one. The separability lemma is an explicit convex decomposition. Commuting pairs satisfy 2t+t^2<=1 at the claimed boundary; anticommuting pairs satisfy a stricter coefficient-sum bound; and the single-edge XX+ZZ witness has a directly computed negative partial-transpose eigenvalue above the same constant. The checker replays all scalar inequalities and the witness sign transition.

value.rationale: The theorem closes the natural low-degree boundary excluded from a newly exact universal result.
